name: research-and-record-city-population-data
title: Research and Record City Population Data
description: Find the 2024 population estimate for a specific city online and record it in a research spreadsheet. Learned from a recorded demonstration (Chrome, Sheets). 1 step(s) must be confirmed by a human before running.
goal: Find the 2024 population estimate for a specific city online and record it in a research spreadsheet.
prerequisites: Access to a web browser with internet connectivity

search_query.description: The query used to find population data.

city_name.description: The name of the city being researched.

spreadsheet_file.description: The name of the spreadsheet file where data is recorded.

target_cell.description: The specific cell where the population value should be entered.

steps.title: Search for city population data
steps.instruction: In Chrome, type '{{search_query}}' into the Searchly search bar and click the 'Search' button.
steps.expect: Search results for the query are displayed.

steps.title: Navigate to official city data
steps.instruction: Click on the first search result link titled '{{city_name}} - Official City Data'.
steps.expect: The browser navigates to the official city data page for {{city_name}}.

steps.title: Identify the 2024 population estimate
steps.instruction: Locate and read the population estimate for 2024 on the city data page.

steps.title: Record population in spreadsheet
steps.instruction: Switch to the '{{spreadsheet_file}}' spreadsheet and type the population value into cell {{target_cell}} for {{city_name}}, then wait for the 'All changes saved' confirmation.
steps.expect: The value is entered and the spreadsheet confirms the changes are saved.
steps.confirmation_reason: Check: The value entered '186,412' differs from the value read '168,412' in the previous step, suggesting a transcription error.

open_questions: Should the population value '186,412' be corrected to '168,412' in the spreadsheet to match the source data?
